title: Three small rules have copies that disagree: water's heat capacity, a naive instant's zone, a finite number
claim: Driven with the same probes, the package's copies of three small rules disagree on 12 of 21 probes: the heat that warms a litre of water by 1 K has three values (0.0011600, 0.0011605 and 0.0011631 kWh, spread 0.26 %); a naive datetime is read as UTC by drift._as_utc and manual_plan._instant and as the host's local zone by open_meteo._ensure_utc (9 h apart under TZ=Asia/Tokyo); and `is this a finite number` is answered four ways (finite_float refuses NaN and inf, entity.payload_number and sensor._as_float pass them, replay_doc.numeric passes True, 'nan' and 'inf').
mechanism: Each rule has no single owner. Water: const.WATER_SPECIFIC_HEAT = 0.00116 kWh/(L K) (thermal_model's tank masses, external_heat), const.WATER_CP_KJ_PER_KG_K = 4.186 with WATER_KG_PER_L = 0.998 (flow_meter.thermal_output_kw), and the literal 4.187 / 3600 in sensor._gap_probe_terms. Naive instants: drift._as_utc (`replace(tzinfo=utc)`), open_meteo._ensure_utc (`astimezone(utc)`, the host zone), manual_plan._instant (UTC), and Home Assistant's dt_util.as_utc at coordinator._utc_age_seconds; debugger._aware keeps a naive stored stamp as UTC text where price_tiles._aware drops it. Numbers: four predicates with four domains. No wrong published value was produced from any of the three here -- the sensor base scrubs a non-finite native value, the 0.26 % sits inside the learners' noise -- so this is the structure, not a defect in an output.

evidence.unit: probes of 21 on which the copies disagree, over the families water_heat (1 of 1), naive_instant (2 of 3) and finite_number (9 of 17)
evidence.machine: Apple M1 (8 cores), Darwin 27.2.0 arm64, Python 3.14.7 (venv-ci)
evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out, load1 150-270; the number is a static or behavioural count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: m8_agree.py --perturb: const.WATER_CP_KJ_PER_KG_K set from WATER_SPECIFIC_HEAT and sensor._gap_probe_terms re-executed with the literal replaced by it; open_meteo._ensure_utc swapped for drift._as_utc; entity.payload_number, sensor.payload_number and replay_doc.numeric swapped for finite_float

metric_definition: probes on which the production implementations of one rule return different answers, summed over the three families (m8_agree.py RESULT <family>_disagreements)
phenomenon_property: A physical constant, a time-zone convention and a value-domain predicate each have one definition in the package, and every other site imports it; where two domains are meant (a payload number that may be NaN, a stored number that may not) the two predicates carry different names that say so.

null_control.note: six families of the same run agree on every probe (dhw_store_tap 24, stored_number 13, soc 5, buffer_prior_in_bounds 8, effective 4, ua_from_rate 3), and naive_instant's aware-datetime probe agrees across all four implementations

proposed_fix_scope: sensor._gap_probe_terms and flow_meter read one water constant from const.py; open_meteo._ensure_utc and drift._as_utc become one function in drift.py with the zone an argument; payload_number is named for what it admits (or refuses NaN). The seven `unknown`/`unavailable` literals (m8_agree.py --seams) join one tuple in inputs.py in the same change.
